scope: Within-host fixed-input development diagnostic. Two sequential runs in prespecified order; not randomized, independent localization accuracy, full-PA coverage or live performance.
controls: Same fixed decoded frames and cutoffs
Same prompt, structured schema and validator
Fresh isolated per-image CLI session with no retained conversation
Same computer and sequential runner; no concurrent model calls
treatment: Explicit primary model ID only; modelUsage auxiliaries do not establish primary model identity.
retry_policy: No external retry, replacement, credential/provider fallback, or correction. Preserve every failure and abstention in the planned denominator. Provider-internal schema retries may occur and are not inferred absent.
authentication: Existing claude.ai subscription only; no API billing or bare mode.
abort_policy: If interrupted or quota/auth unavailable, preserve all completed/error attempts and unattempted denominator; do not relabel them model abstentions. Do not resume into existing output directories.
outcomes: Non-overlapping outer measured phases and separately nested provider phases
Total wall time, per-attempt service time and backlog
Paired status/point disagreement, if both valid; not accuracy
model_identity_rule: Require one matching initialization model and all assistant primary models equal to requested ID; literal [1m] request allows only removal of that context suffix on assistant reports. Missing or different primary model is an error, no silent substitute.
limitations: Prespecified sequential order, server/network/cache/load may differ
Two calls can disagree stochastically; no inferential speed/quality ranking
Structured output is a different protocol from old free-text JSON CV-9
No new human reference for these ten points
No physical full-PA or live broadcast validation
